Package com.miniandmore.app.service

Class ZohoOAuthService

java.lang.Object
com.miniandmore.app.service.ZohoOAuthService
@Service public class ZohoOAuthService extends Object
Zoho Books OAuth: builds the authorization URL, exchanges an auth code for a refresh token, and resolves/caches short-lived access tokens from the stored refresh token.
